scope: 64 reviewed named PUSH/RET roots; two count-two REPE/REPNE early-stop targets extend the frozen 62-root oracle. The executable i386 oracle uses its process segment bases; static i386 analysis receives no segment-base contract.
review_basis: Both roots start with ECX=2 and an exact first comparison that fails the repeat condition in long mode. The fixture adds post-count ECX to df_memory_target minus one; one completed iteration yields the named target. The native driver executes all inputs 0..255 on both architectures. Static i386 must abstain because ES may differ from DS.
